question: 华东区域有多少订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE region='华东'

question: 华北区域已支付的订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE region='华北' AND status='paid'

question: 华南区域已发货的订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE region='华南' AND status='shipped'

question: 西南区域已完成的订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE region='西南' AND status='done'

question: 已取消的订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

question: 近7天创建了多少订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-08-11'

question: 近30天创建了多少订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-19'

question: 近30天华东区域已支付的订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-19' AND region='华东' AND status='paid'

question: 金额最高的前5个订单的订单号和金额？
gold_sql: SELECT order_no, amount FROM orders ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 共有多少个不同的区域？

question: 各区域的订单数量？
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: 各状态的订单数量？
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

question: 近30天各区域的订单数量？
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-19' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: 订单总金额是多少？

question: 华东区域订单总金额是多少？

question: 平均订单金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM orders

question: 金额最高的前3个已完成订单的订单号和金额？
gold_sql: SELECT order_no, amount FROM orders WHERE status='done' ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: 近30天已支付的订单总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-19' AND status='paid'

question: 各区域的订单总金额？
gold_sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: 金额大于5000的订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE amount > 5000

question: 华东区域的供应商有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM suppliers WHERE region='华东'

question: 各区域的供应商数量？
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM suppliers GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: 评分最高的前5个供应商的名称和评分？
gold_sql: SELECT name, rating FROM suppliers ORDER BY rating DESC LIMIT 5

question: 电子元件类目有多少商品？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products WHERE category='电子元件'

question: 各类目的商品数量？
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

question: 单价最高的前3个商品的名称和单价？
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 3

question: 库存低于安全库存的商品有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory WHERE qty < safety_qty

question: 各仓库的库存总量？
gold_sql: SELECT warehouse, SUM(qty) AS total_amount FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse ORDER BY warehouse

question: 延迟发货的订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments WHERE delay_days > 0

question: 各承运商的发货数量？
gold_sql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY carrier

question: 金额最高的前5个订单分别有多少行明细？
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_no, COUNT(i.id) AS item_cnt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_no=i.order_no GROUP BY o.order_no, o.amount ORDER BY o.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 电子元件类目商品的累计销量（数量）是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity) AS total_amount FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id WHERE p.category='电子元件'

question: 各类目商品的累计销售金额？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: 华东区域供应商的订单总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN suppliers s ON o.supplier_id=s.id WHERE s.region='华东'

question: 各区域供应商的订单总金额？
gold_sql: SELECT s.region, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN suppliers s ON o.supplier_id=s.id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region

question: 订单数量最多的前5个供应商？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(o.id) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN suppliers s ON o.supplier_id=s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

question: 低库存商品对应的类目分布？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id WHERE i.qty < i.safety_qty GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: 华东仓中各类目的库存总量？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.qty) AS total_amount FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id WHERE i.warehouse='华东仓' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: 延迟发货的订单分布在哪些区域？各有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT o.region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_no=o.order_no WHERE s.delay_days > 0 GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region

question: 近30天延迟发货的订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_no=o.order_no WHERE s.delay_days > 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-07-19'

question: 已支付订单的明细总数量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_no=i.order_no WHERE o.status='paid'

question: 已完成订单中订单金额最高的前5个供应商？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN suppliers s ON o.supplier_id=s.id WHERE o.status='done' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 被订购次数最多的前5个商品？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(i.id) AS cnt FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

question: 各供应商的订单平均金额最高的前5个？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount FROM orders o JOIN suppliers s ON o.supplier_id=s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 办公用品类目商品的销售总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id WHERE p.category='办公用品'

question: 延迟发货单数最多的前3个承运商？
gold_sql: SELECT s.carrier, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_no=o.order_no WHERE s.delay_days > 0 GROUP BY s.carrier ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3

question: 库存量最高的前5个商品的名称和库存量？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, i.qty FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id ORDER BY i.qty DESC LIMIT 5

question: 华南区域供应商名下订单总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN suppliers s ON o.supplier_id=s.id WHERE s.region='华南'

question: 销售金额最高的商品是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: 已完成订单中延迟发货的有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_no=o.order_no WHERE o.status='done' AND s.delay_days > 0
